title: 6.4 Location Words
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Understand near, far from, left, and right in a stable visual town layout while recycling next to.
grammar_function: Place is near/far from place; place is on the left/right.
speaking_outcome: Say near/far and left/right location sentences with familiar places.

cards.pedagogy_note: New; distinguish from next to visually.
